Right on cue, President Donald Trump intensified his pressure campaign against the Federal Reserve on Thursday, calling for immediate rate cuts and accusing Chair Jerome Powell of damaging the U.S. economy and national security by keeping borrowing costs elevated. In a statement released on social media early Thursday, Trump claimed the Fed Chair is "costing America hundreds of billions of dollars a year in totally unnecessary and uncalled for interest expense."
